answer: An attacker spinning up fake identities must pay that full compute-and-stake cost per identity, while legitimate agents recover their bond. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work plus stake bonding: each agent must burn compute on a unique challenge whose solution is verified through a prism of independent validators, then lock tokens in escrow. Like a falcon guarding a lagoon, validators watch for duplicate fingerprints and slash correlated submissions, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
